summary: In checks mode only DIRTY blocks a complete passing check verdict. Merge mode waits for an actual merge and selects the newest attempt per CheckRun name/workflow or StatusContext context. A failed or cancelled selected attempt ends the wait unless merge_state is UNSTABLE. Pending peers do not block that failure verdict. In merge mode merged and closed outcomes retain precedence; checks mode still judges the watched head's checks after a merge or close. Head supersession retains precedence in both modes, and every report carries the observed merge_state.
title: The ci-wait checks verdict blocks only on a dirty merge state
